ac2.installedFrom: npm i agenticow@0.2.4 + @ruvector/rvf-node@0.2.3 in /tmp/agenticow-recon/fixture-env (no in-repo install)

ac5.verdict: agenticow exposes no status model (no degraded/expired/rejected/quarantined/rolled_back states). Those STATE values must live app-level (27.1 branch_registry / 27.6 gate) per recon §2 invariant-8 seam. Demonstrated mechanical equivalents:

rolled_back_analog.mechanism: rollback(checkpointId) closes+rm-s owned poison nodes, derives fresh child from the target checkpoint
rolled_back_analog.demonstrated: b1 poison (5 adds + override id 100) reverted; poison files rm'd; clean edits preserved

quarantined_analog.mechanism: checkpoint(label) freezes the poisoned state as a COW node (retention = until close()/rm; no TTL in library)
quarantined_analog.demonstrated: b2 checkpoint('quarantine-poison') froze bad state; child then rm'd; base untouched

rejected_analog.mechanism: do-not-promote + close() + rm child (no native reject concept)
rejected_analog.demonstrated: b2 discarded with zero blast radius on base

degraded_analog.mechanism: fork({nativeAnn}) try/catch → exact JS read-through, mem.nativeAnn === false

expired_analog.mechanism: NONE in library (no TTL/expiry; branches persist until close()/rm)
